source_refs.note: Exercise 12.3, Question 8: continuity of a piecewise cost function at x = 10 (book p.236). Answer key PDF 310: yes.

blocks.prompt: 8 The cost to produce \(x\) units is: \[C(x) = \begin{cases} 5x + 20, & x \le 10 \\ 6x + 10, & x > 10 \end{cases}\]Is the cost function continuous at \(x = 10\)?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 6 jaisa hi sawal hai: production cost do formulas mein, aur formula \(x = 10\) par badalta hai.
Humein dekhna hai ke 10 units par dono formulas ek hi cost dete hain ya nahi.
Plan: \(C(10)\), LHL aur RHL nikalein aur teeno shartein check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x \le 10\) ke liye \(C(x) = 5x + 20\), aur \(x > 10\) ke liye \(C(x) = 6x + 10\).
Humein find karna hai: kya \(C\) point \(x = 10\) par continuous hai?
Tareeqa: \(C\) point \(x = c\) par continuous tab hai jab (i) \(C(c)\) defined ho, (ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} C(x)\) exist kare yani LHL = RHL, (iii) yeh limit \(C(c)\) ke barabar ho. Business ki zubaan mein: \(c\) par cost achanak uchhalti (jump) nahi.

Shart (i): \(C(10)\) nikalein
\[C(10) = 5(10) + 20 = 70\]
Kyun: Pehle formula ke saath \(x \le 10\) hai, is liye 10 units pehle formula mein aate hain.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 10^-} C(x) = \lim_{x \to 10^-} (5x + 20)\]
\[= 50 + 20 = 70\]
Kyun: 10 se kam units par pehla formula lagta hai.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 10^+} C(x) = \lim_{x \to 10^+} (6x + 10)\]
\[= 60 + 10 = 70\]
Kyun: 10 se zyada units par doosra formula lagta hai.
Dhyan dein: Right hand limit mein bhi value 10 hi rakhte hain, 11 nahi; limit "qareeb aane" ki baat hai, agle whole number ki nahi.

Shart (ii) aur (iii)
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = 70 = C(10)\]
Kyun: Teeno shartein poori, is liye \(C\) point \(x = 10\) par continuous hai. 10 units ki hadd par cost mein koi jump nahi; sirf per unit cost 5 se 6 ho jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[C(9.9) = 49.5 + 20 = 69.5\]
\[C(10.1) = 60.6 + 10 = 70.6\]
Kyun: 10 se zara kam aur zara zyada units par cost 70 ke qareeb hai, jo continuity ki tasdeeq hai.
blocks.final_answer: Haan. \(C\) point \(x = 10\) par continuous hai (LHL \(=\) RHL \(= C(10) = 70\))
